proposal.reason: Primary change removes CollNet transport setup/connect/free paths and channel-peer handling. Additional independently substantive changes remove CollNet plugin loading and network/proxy state (network), delete CollNet topology graph construction/search/connection (graph-search), remove CollNet device kernels and replace algorithm slot 2 with reserved null entries (kernels), update runtime planning/pattern/channel scheduling plus tuner-selection fallback for retired IDs (enqueue), and disable/zero CollNet algorithm modeling while preserving stable external algorithm IDs (tuning).
